text:
For hanging strips like Command strips, pull the tab slowly straight down and parallel to the wall, stretching it along its length until it releases. If it resists, warm it with a hairdryer for 20 to 30 seconds or saw behind it with dental floss. The team note's seven-day wait isn't standard guidance for these strips, since they can be removed whenever needed, so I wouldn't delay removal for a week. This assumes hanging strips; medical or skin adhesives need a different method.

CONFIDENCE: 70
